Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Day 1 was a draft (3 Third Ed, 2 SoC).

Jared Strait limped into the finals with a 1 GW, 4 VP finish after the two
preliminary rounds (tied for 5th with another 1 and4, but ahead on Tournament
points). And then went on to sweep the final table (starting with his prey,
Shane Strait).

The other finalists:
David Buerger (2 and 8 in the preliminaries)
Eric Chiang (1 and 5)
Mark Loughman (1 and 5)
Shane Strait (1 and 5)

We had 28 players participate. Four others garnered a GW in the prelims:

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
>Day 1 was a draft (3 Third Ed, 2 SoC).

Day 2 was a standard constructed affair, with 31 players, but only 30
at a time. (One player played the first two rounds and dropped, and a
replacement played only in the third round.)

The finalists:

Mark Loughman (Carna/Neighbor John permacept/Smiling Jack) with
something better than 2 GW and 8 VPs going into the finals

bleeding

Jeffrey Thompson (Obtenebration gets out the Vote) with 2 GW and 8 VPs
going into the finals

bleeding

David Berger (Arika and friends stealth vote) with something better
than 2 GW and 8 VPs going into the finals

bleeding

Jared Strait (potence rush with dominate minions for a few Deflections
and Conditionings) with 1 GW and 5 or 6 VPs

bleeding

Mike Ooi (Ambrogino Giovanni merged bleed with block denial, Ex
Nihilo, Soul Gem, and Virolax Facility) with 1 GW and 6.5 VPs

All players had a shot at the US Championships, as it would have been
their fourth game win in the weekend, and finals tournament wins count
more for the tiebreakers, with the exception of Mike Ooi, who was 1 GW
behind the curve. Other tiebreakers would have to have been used
should he have won the finals table to determine the US Champion.

Mike, Jeff, and Jared shared the first round table on this day, so
they were all painfully aware of what the others could do and how they
should sit.

Jared and Mike had no choice, and Jeff sat as Jared's predator. David
sat as Jared's predator, and then Mark sat as Mike's prey (as he had
also played against Jared in an earlier round.)

Mark had the perfect opening crypt, and soon had Carna + Bowl of
Convergence + Sniper Rifle + Leather Jacket along with Neigherbor
John, Frondator, Cohn Rose, and Martin Frankel.

Jared managed to oust Mike, and David was able to oust Jared. Mark
ousted both Jeff and David for the win.

Mark Loughman got 3 VP + GW in the finals, showing clearly why he is
in the V:TES Hall of Fame.

All hail the new US Champion, Mark Loughman of Newark, Ohio!

though.

>> 1x Political Stranglehold

Influence and Political Stranglehold. They are a must include. I
should have dropped the Consanguineous Boons. I intended to use them
for grand-preys/grand-predators but I never had them in hand when it

rounds.

Replacing cards when it isn't my turn really doesn't matter.
